I have farmed maize for many years, so I know that using fertilizer and good seed is the only way to get a decent harvest from this rented plot. I will apply both chemical fertilizer and some manure that I have saved, because the soil here is tired and maize needs food to grow well. I cannot afford irrigation, so I am praying the rains come on time, but I will buy herbicide to save my children from too much weeding. My family will do most of the work, but I may hire a few young men to help with planting and harvesting since I have other plots to manage too.
